This vignette walks end-to-end through the [Strand AI Platform](https://strandai.com)
API using the `strand` R package: upload a Whole Slide Image (WSI), submit a
Lattice H&E to multiplex protein inference job, wait for completion, and pull
results back as a `SpatialExperiment`.

> The chunks below set `eval = FALSE` so the vignette renders cleanly on CRAN
> without network access. To run them yourself, mint an API key at
> `app.strandai.com/settings/api-keys`, set `STRAND_API_KEY`, and run
> interactively.

## 1. Set up

```{r}
library(strandai)

# Reads STRAND_API_KEY; for local development:
# Sys.setenv(STRAND_BASE_URL = "http://localhost:3000")
client <- strand_client()
client
```

## 2. Upload a slide

`strand_upload_file()` initiates a resumable session and streams the file to
GCS in 8 MiB chunks. The final PUT triggers automatic ingest, and the function
polls only until the upload status leaves `uploading`. Poll the owned sample
until ingest has resolved prediction-ready dimensions and scale before pricing.

```{r}
upload <- strand_upload_file(client, "slide.svs", progress = TRUE)
upload

deadline <- Sys.time() + 10 * 60
poll_seconds <- 2
repeat {
  uploaded_sample <- strand_samples_get(client, upload$id)
  if (!identical(uploaded_sample$ownership, "mine")) {
    stop("uploaded sample resolved as ", uploaded_sample$ownership)
  }
  if (identical(uploaded_sample$status, "ready")) {
    geometry <- c(
      uploaded_sample$width_px,
      uploaded_sample$height_px,
      uploaded_sample$mpp
    )
    if (length(geometry) != 3L || any(!is.finite(geometry)) || any(geometry <= 0)) {
      stop("sample is ready but lacks prediction dimensions or MPP")
    }
    break
  }
  if (grepl("failed$", uploaded_sample$status)) {
    stop("ingest failed: ", uploaded_sample$status)
  }
  if (!uploaded_sample$status %in% c("uploading", "preprocessing")) {
    stop("unexpected ingest status: ", uploaded_sample$status)
  }
  if (Sys.time() >= deadline) {
    stop("sample was not prediction-ready after 10 minutes: ", uploaded_sample$status)
  }
  Sys.sleep(poll_seconds)
  poll_seconds <- min(poll_seconds * 1.5, 15)
}

message(
  "slide metadata ready: ", uploaded_sample$width_px, "x", uploaded_sample$height_px,
  " at ", uploaded_sample$mpp, " um/px"
)
```

## 3. Work with samples

`strand_samples_list()` lists owned samples, the public cohort, or both.
Every item has an `ownership` discriminator and a canonical `id` accepted by
`strand_samples_get()`. Owned detail includes recent inference jobs; public
detail contains public geometry and marker channels without job history.

```{r}
page <- strand_samples_list(client, scope = "all")
sample <- strand_samples_get(client, page$items[[1]]$id)

if (sample$ownership == "mine") {
  sample <- strand_patch_sample(
    client, sample$id,
    name = "Baseline biopsy",
    fields = list(tags = c("baseline", "responding")),
    mpp = 0.26
  )
}
```

## 4. Price credits

Tissue-tile counting can finish after the sample metadata becomes ready. Retry
the side-effect-free dry run only on its exact `sample_not_ready` response. A
successful dry run is the final prediction-readiness check.

```{r}
markers <- c("CD3e", "CD4", "Ki67", "CD45")
deadline <- Sys.time() + 10 * 60
poll_seconds <- 2
repeat {
  est <- tryCatch(
    strand_predict(client, upload$id, markers, dry_run = TRUE),
    strand_api_error = function(e) e
  )
  if (!inherits(est, "strand_api_error")) break
  if (!identical(est$status_code, 409L) ||
      !identical(est$error_code, "sample_not_ready")) {
    stop(est)
  }
  if (Sys.time() >= deadline) {
    stop("sample was not priceable after 10 minutes")
  }
  Sys.sleep(poll_seconds)
  poll_seconds <- min(poll_seconds * 1.5, 15)
}

message(
  est$patch_count, " retained tissue positions x ", est$marker_count, " markers = ",
  est$estimated_credits, " credits"
)
message("org balance: ", est$org_balance)
```

## 5. Submit and wait

Submission **atomically reserves** the estimated credits in the same database
transaction that creates the job. If your org has insufficient credits, you'll
see a `strand_insufficient_credits_error`.

```{r}
job <- strand_predict(client, upload$id, markers)
status <- strand_job_wait(job, progress = TRUE)
stopifnot(status$status == "completed")
```

### Choosing a model

Pass `model = "v0.7"` to select the current dispatchable Lattice version
explicitly. Omitting `model` lets the platform pick the same current default.
Older `"v0.4"` and `"v0.5"` labels can appear on historical jobs but are
sunset for new submissions.

```{r}
job <- strand_predict(client, upload$id, markers, model = "v0.7")
```

### Fire-and-forget

For long pipeline runs, pass `wait = FALSE` to `strand_run()` to return the
job handle as soon as upload + submit complete. The job continues server-side
— you can poll or download later from the same or a fresh process.

```{r}
job <- strand_run(client, "slide.svs", markers, wait = FALSE)
# ...later:
status <- strand_job_wait(job)
spe <- strand_download_results(job)
```

## 6. Download as SpatialExperiment

`strand_download_results()` walks the OME-Zarr result store via the
API-key-authenticated proxy and assembles the channels into a
[`SpatialExperiment`](https://bioconductor.org/packages/SpatialExperiment).
Rows are markers, columns are pixels; spatial coordinates are stored in
`spatialCoords(spe)`.

For very large slides, supply `path = "out/"` to mirror the zarr store to disk
and read selectively with `Rarr` instead.

```{r}
spe <- strand_download_results(job)
spe
```

## Error handling

```{r}
tryCatch(
  strand_predict(client, upload$id, markers),
  strand_insufficient_credits_error = function(e) {
    message("Need ", e$required, " more credits.")
  }
)
```
